Attribute.Name: D&B Match Address Line 1 CALC
Attribute.ValueTemplate: <derive expr="{ refs := iterate(references("entity", "AdressReference"), 'referencetarget()'), addrValues := iterate(refs, 'if(exact(value("a_AddressStatus"), "CURRENT"), concatenate(value("a_AddressLine1"), "<multisep/>", value("a_AddressLine2")), "")'), addrlines := multivalue2list(listitem(addrValues,1)), result := if (exact(listitem(addrlines,1),"NO ADDRESS LINE 1"),listitem(addrlines,2),listitem(addrlines,1)) } trim(result)"/>
